title: 07 ATG Aerial Geometry / Doppler
description: Slant range, elevation, Doppler — ADS-B + GS geometry (not satellite).

panels.title: Doppler
panels.description: atg_doppler_hz — 3D geometric Doppler from the ADS-B velocity vector projected on the GS→aircraft LOS. No pre-compensation is configured, so the residual equals the full Doppler.

panels.title: Timing advance
panels.description: atg_timing_advance_us (round-trip delay from live slant range) vs the N_TA,max ceiling of 1001.6 µs for μ=1 (TS 38.213).

panels.title: CP budget
panels.description: NO DATA — Requires Sionna RT (set ATG_SIONNA=1 and install sionna) — not running. RMS delay spread vs the 2343.8 ns normal CP length for μ=1 (TS 38.211). Delay spread requires the Sionna CIR.

panels.title: Roll / pitch / turn rate
panels.description: Attitude estimated from ADS-B kinematics (coordinated-turn bank, vertical-rate pitch) — correlate bank with fuselage loss.
